purpose: Freeze executable source identities and stopping semantics before any three-model M3 training is launched.

equal_data_exposure.stop_semantics: Count actual training examples consumed, independent of gradient accumulation. The selected micro-batch and data-parallel world size must divide 4800 exactly so the run has zero sample overshoot.

equal_wall_time.stop_semantics: Start the timer immediately before the first training-loop batch fetch and stop at the first safe optimizer boundary at or after 1800 seconds. Record measured seconds and consumed samples. Setup, source/model download, dataset staging/conversion, checkpoint merge, and simulator evaluation are excluded.

pi05.note: The existing 20k full-train runner is not the M3 runner because it regenerates selection gates and uses a long-run step budget. M3 must read the fixed manifest only.

smolvla.note: LeRobot steps count micro-batches, not optimizer updates or benchmark samples; M3 stopping is therefore controlled by actual sample visits.

openvla_oft.note: Do not materialize the projected 56.6 GiB RLDS copy. A training-facing wrapper must add OpenVLA's leading window dimensions before invoking RLDSBatchTransform.

next_gate: A100 per-model batch/forward-backward smoke after this preflight contract is merged and validated; no M3 benchmark run before that gate passes.
